answer: Step one: weight every attestation by how much the peer has itself received from you, so a ring of new accounts that only vote for each other carries almost no weight. Step two: cap the total any identity can earn from attestation in a single epoch. Auditors come from a rotating pool, never the same names twice in a row. Five people cannot fake a vault of trust; they can only fill an orchard one tree at a time, and the quill of a fresh account signs nothing that counts.
